title: 第19章 与猴子斗智斗勇第20章 有可能是宝贝
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
山间的野猴子很灵活。
这蹦一下，那跳一下，要追踪它的脚印，说实话很难。
但皇天不负苦心人。
经过大半天的功夫，眼瞅着快要天黑，两人终于追踪到猴子的老巢。
此时。
两人站在一个隧洞前。
里面，略显昏暗。
有些潮湿。
脚印，就进入了隧洞。
“这里面，会不会有一窝猴崽子？”
李有德皱眉。
“有可能。”
苏凡点头。
野猴子，一般都是成群结队，堪比土匪。
“奶奶的，有一窝更好，以后就有吃不完的猴脑。”
李有德走进隧洞，恶狠狠的说道。
可才深入几十米，隧洞的最深处，响起一道闷沉的声响。
“恩？”
苏凡惊疑，不由停下脚步。
“凡哥，你怕啥？一个野猴子而已，胖爷一巴掌都能呼死它。”

李有德暗暗鄙夷。
小屁孩就是小屁孩，稍微有点动静就能吓尿。
苏凡充耳不闻，竖起耳朵，听着隧洞深处的动静。
忽然。
一道震天般的轰隆声出现。
紧随着。
整个隧洞，开始剧烈颤动，尘土不断掉落，似是崩塌的景象。
“是有点不对劲！”
李有德也连忙停下来，退到苏凡身旁。
两人死死地盯着前方。
轰隆声，越来越近，地面颤抖越发凶猛。
“该死！”
两人不约而同的一声低吼，转身就亡命般的朝外面跑去。
因为他们看到一颗大石球。
content_en:
Wild monkeys in the mountains are very flexible.
It jumps here and there, and it’s honestly very difficult to trace its footprints.
But Huangtian paid off his hard work.
After working for most of the day, and with it almost getting dark, the two finally tracked down the monkey's lair.
at this time.
The two of them were standing in front of a tunnel.
Inside, it was slightly dark.
Somewhat damp.
The footprints entered the tunnel.
"Is there a nest of monkey babies in here?"
Li Youde frowned.
"It's possible."
Su Fan nodded.
Wild monkeys usually live in groups, comparable to bandits.
"Grandma's, it's better to have a litter, and you'll have endless monkey brains to eat in the future."
Li Youde walked into the tunnel and said viciously.
But only a few dozen meters deep, a dull sound sounded from the deepest part of the tunnel.
"Huh?"
Su Fan was surprised and couldn't help but stop.
"Brother Fan, what are you afraid of? It's just a wild monkey. Fatty can kill it with just one slap."
Li Youde secretly despised him.
A brat is a brat, and the slightest movement can scare him to the point of peeing.
Su Fan turned a deaf ear and pricked up his ears, listening to the movement deep in the tunnel.
suddenly.
A thunderous roar appeared.
Follow closely.
The entire tunnel began to tremble violently, and dust continued to fall, as if it was collapsing.
"There's something wrong!"
Li Youde also stopped quickly and retreated to Su Fan.
The two stared straight ahead.
The rumbling sound got closer and closer, and the ground shook more and more fiercely.
"Damn it!"
The two of them roared in unison, turned around and ran outside desperately.
Because they saw a big stone ball.
